name: Secrets Sweep
summary: Audits a folder tree for API keys, tokens and credential files that drifted out of your vault, and can move them in.
story: Keys end up in .env files, notes and old scripts. This finds them and moves them to one private vault with symlinks so nothing breaks.

launcher.short: Find keys and secrets outside the vault
launcher.long: Audits a folder tree for keys and credential files; --fix moves them into the vault and leaves symlinks.
